Autodesk Inc. is leveraging AI disruption in product development through its innovative
Neural CAD and AI-powered solutions like Sketch AutoConstrain in Fusion. These
technologies utilize generative AI to create flexible, intelligent designs and automate
design processes, significantly enhancing design capabilities. The integration of AI
in generating design revisions and validating them against core parametric models
